Condition : 1 - 13.	CONDITIONS AND REASONS

The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 17th, November, 2003, the erection of a roof extension with a maximum height of 2.2m, maximum width of 4.65m and a maximum depth of 4.0m that adds 18.6m3 to the volume of the original dwelling, as shown on Drawing sheet 1 dated 11/01/03, and the erection of a single storey rear extension with a maximum height of 2.5m, maximum width of 1.7m and a maximum depth of 5.50m that adds 20.60m3 to the volume of the original dwelling, as shown on Drawing sheet 1 dated 11/01/03, this calculates to a total of 39.20m3 was lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990. 

The proposed development consisting of a roof extension and single storey rear extension falls within Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B and Schedule 2,  Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995. Planning permission is therefore not required.

INFORMATIVE

1.	Any roof lights located within the front roofslope of the dwellinghouse shall be flush with the existing roofslope.


Rear roof extension
The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 17th, November, 2003, the erection of a roof extension with a maximum height of 2.2m, maximum width of 4.65m and a maximum depth of 4.0m that adds 18.6m3 to the volume of the original dwelling, as shown on Drawing sheet 1 dated 11/01/03, was lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 and therefore does not require planning permission for the following reason:

The proposed roof extension falls within Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.

INFORMATIVE

1.	Any roof lights located within the front roofslope of the dwellinghouse shall be flush with the existing roofslope.
